metadata.datasource:
Prepared for Negs from the manufacturer's datasheet: FUJIFILM ETERNA 400 brochure, Ref. No. KB-0508E, (c) 2005 FUJIFILM Corporation, page 1 (spectral sensitivity, characteristic curves, minimum and midscale-neutral spectral density; RMS granularity 3.7). PDF sha256 91f1461a4e40c370098d29abbbbe3b24f54ded18be17b17cbafa0aeea48f62ad. Data (c) FUJIFILM Corporation. The curves were read from the PDF's vector paths (tools/film_profiles/extract_pdf.py); the points and axis calibration are in data/profile-sources/fujifilm-cine/fujifilm_eterna_400/.
Method: spektrafilm's public-era profile creator by Andrea Volpato (commit b2c7fe6), steps 1-8: D-min removed, log E zero where green is 0.2 over D-min plus 3 stops, dye spectra reconstructed (dmid_dmin) from spektrafilm's generic_a dye set (Giorgianni, Madden & Kriss 2009, p. 112, via spektrafilm) because the datasheet gives no per-dye spectra, status-M unmixing, a 3 norm_cdfs curve fit, sensitivity balance, midscale alignment 'none' (of none/green/mid, the lowest grey-ramp neutrality error, none 0.034, green 0.067, mid 0.061, among those whose kodak_2383 neutral filters fall in the shipped films' range), densitometer normalisation. Then Negs's steps: sensitivity scaled so an 18.4 % grey gives raw exposure 1 per channel under the reference illuminant, and spektrafilm's grey-ramp refinement run on spektrafilm 28bf883 through kodak_2383 at data_trustability 0.3. hanatos2025 adaptation window [399.3, 21.6, 615.4, 60.5] fitted on the reflectance corpus (Otsu (https://github.com/enneract/otsu2018), Munsell (https://zenodo.org/records/3269912), human skin (https://www.nist.gov/programs-projects/reflectance-measurements-human-skin), forest colors (https://zenodo.org/records/3269920)) with a weak prior toward the median of spektrafilm's stored windows. Tools and procedure: tools/film_profiles, docs/adding-film-stocks.md.
Negs choices: reference illuminant T, colour-science's incandescent SPD, as Kodak's tungsten Vision3 profiles (tungsten stock, exposed at 3200 K); viewing illuminant D50; target print kodak_2383; log_sensitivity_density_over_min 0.4 as printed; spectra left empty (null) outside the published wavelength range; characteristic curves converted from stops (log10 H = 0.30103 x stops); use 'cine' and antihalation 'strong' as the Vision3 and Eterna profiles.
